description: Max and Karla visit his deceased uncle's farming estate where it is confirmed that they will inherit it. Financial expert Max tries to manage the farm but collides with manager Georg whom Max soon suspects to have an affair with Karla.

Title: 811. Wild Horse Rustlers
description: The setting is WWII and Hans Beckman has arrived from Germany with a mission of destroying horses before they can be sold to the government. He kidnaps and replaces his twin brother as ranch foreman, but Tom Cameron suspects something is wrong and with sidekick Fuzzy sets out to learn the truth.

Title: 812. En vår i vapen
description: It's the spring of 1940. Kalle, Gustav and Åke gets drafted to the war and has to leave their loved ones.

Title: 815. El hombre de la máscara de hierro
816. Ídolos
description: Clara Bell, a famous French actress, rejects the protection of a producer and falls in love with a handsome Spaniard. But the story is complicated and his love will not come to fruition.

Title: 817. Bergführer Lorenz
description: Mountain guide's son Stephan leaves his family for a city beauty in Zurich. Disillusioned, he returns home, where his bride and a test of his resolve await.

Title: 822. Gabriele Dambrone
description: Gabi is devastated when her fiance leaves her for another woman. She finds solace with the artist Paul who takes her to a wonderful winter resort in the Alpes. What Gabi doesn't know: Paul has a wife and two children.

Title: 827. Bad Men of Thunder Gap
description: Texas Rangers Tex Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Jim Steele (James Newill) arrive in Thunder Gap as undercover Rangers to investigate the hijacking of supply wagons of food for the miners. They come to town as members of a medicine-wagon troupe headed by another Ranger, Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson). Tex discovers the offices of the Hard Rock Mining Company being robbed by Ed Ransom (Jack Ingram), owner of the local freight company. One of Ransom's gang slugs Tex and kills an official of the mining company. Ransom tells the townspeople he arrived at the scene too late to stop the robbery and the killing and blames Tex.

Title: 828. Krishna Prema
description: This film depicts Radha's love towards Sri Krishna.

Title: 829. Silver City Raiders
description: Lucky finds he no longer owns his ranch when Bart Dawson appears with a Spanish land grant which gives him, as sole heir, ownership of all the ranches in the valley. When Lucky refuses to give in to Dawson and then has his cattle rustled, he becomes suspicious and heads for Santa Fe to check the land records. But Dawson learns about his trip and sends his men to make sure he doesn't get there.

Title: 836. In the Name of the Motherland
description: The film deals with a Russian battalion under siege by the Germans during the Second World War.

Title: 838. Non mi muovo!
description: Former batsman Carlo Mezzetti, who has been left homeless with his daughter Annuccia, takes advantage of favorable situations and legal loopholes to find temporary accommodation, illegally occupying vacant houses.

Title: 839. Kungsgatan
description: Young woman moves to Stockholm for a better life, soon finds herself working as a prostitute.

Title: 840. The Adventures of a Rookie
description: Two clumsy guys accidentally end up at a women-only boarding house dinner. When the cook gets scarlet fever, quarantine traps them inside with all the female residents.

Title: 841. Kajan går till sjöss
description: Kajan, a young boy, spends the summer with his friends working on a barge, earning extra money in the ports with their song and dance number. A young countess runs away from home and joins Kajan and his friends.

Title: 843. Wagon Tracks West
description: Fleetwing, now a doctor, treats Gabby who has fever from contaminated water. He and Elliott know ranchers caused it, harming Pawnee. Agent Warren and Clawtooth use the water crisis to force tribes off their land.

Title: 844. Sayon no kane
description: From an anecdote during Japan's occupation of Taiwan:After an aboriginal girl who revered her teacher/master dies crossing a river in a storm, villagers pay tribute, children call out her name, and a memorial bell is struck.

Title: 845. The Taming of the Shrew
description: William Shakespeare's "The Taming of the Shrew" set in modern Hungary. Life is hell with Pálma Benedek, the spoiled daughter of a rich industrialist. The whole house, the entire staff is on the run from her, even her father is eager to get rid of her somehow. The only way out would be a suitable husband to take her somewhere, preferably as far away as possible. But even the most stubborn suitors leave as soon as they get to know the pretty girl. One fine day, chance brings her together with a gentleman named Pál Jámbor, who takes a fancy to the shrew.

Title: 846. Death Rides the Plains
description: Gowdey's scheme is to repeatedly sell a ranch by mail and to tell the buyer to bring the money in cash. His men then kill the buyer and keep the cash. But when he sells a ranch to Luke Jones, Jones asks his cousin Fuzzy to join him and Fuzzy brings Rocky Cameron and that spells trouble for Gowdey.

Title: 847. Neiti Tuittupää
description: Young, remarkably independent (for the times) woman decides how to make her own way through life, without any interfering patriarchal characters dictating it for her, whilst keeps suitors dangling on a string as to whether she will accede to their marriage proposals.

Title: 848. Le soleil a toujours raison
description: Tonio is a delivery man in Provence engaged to marry Micheline. His life becomes complicated when he meets a gypsy woman named Georgia, whose presence forces him to reconsider his future and his commitment to his fiancée.

Title: 849. Geliebter Schatz
description: When a wife reads a love letter addressed to her husband, written by an unknown female, all hell breaks lose.

Title: 850. Tenting Tonight on the Old Camp Ground
description: In order to obtain a stage coach mail contract, a new road must be built. A gang of outlaws try to prevent the building of the road.

Title: 852. Border Buckaroos
description: With the owner of a ranch now dead, Melford takes aim at the two heirs. The will states they must arrive by a certain date or the property will revert to his Lawyer cohort. When his men try to stop their arrival the Texas Rangers appear just in time. Tex poses as a hired gunman and Jim as one of the heirs as they try to find out why Melford wants an apparently worthless ranch.

Title: 853. Hon trodde det var han
description: The famous author Mark Storm's publisher is unhappy with his books and asks him to write books in a more popular genre, crime for example. When Mark Storm comes to his apartment, he finds a burglar, Kurre. He notices that they have a physical similarity and they change identity, which makes it possible for Storm to make empirical studies in the world of crime.

Title: 854. Taqdeer
description: Two unrelated children get separated from their parents in a giant fair and grow up in separate households.

Title: 855. Kohlhiesels Töchter
description: Remake of an Ernst Lubitsch silent comedy, about a farm boy who is fond of two sisters, one of them beautiful, and the other, not so much.

Title: 856. German Industrial Manpower
description: A training film for OSS agents on how to analyze statistics obtained about German industrialization and war production.

Title: 858. Two Fisted Justice
description: Wells Fargo hires three cowboys to clean up a lawless town.

Title: 860. Noche fantástica
description: A railway accident causes the passengers to stay for some time at a nearby village. Their individual stories will develop as they wait for the train to continue their journey.

Title: 861. Zirkus Renz
description: Renz dreams of creating a unique circus but faces tough competition. His efforts include training young Bettina to become a top equestrian. He realizes that he loves her only after she falls for fellow rider Harms, Renz's best friend.

Title: 862. Night in the Harbor
description: Early 1940s, during WW2, pitch black waters except for a moon-shadow over the waves. Surrounded by minefields and the fog slips in the sweeping headlights of the cargo ship S/S Rune. But the ship bows relentlessly forward through the night.

Title: 864. Port d'attache
description: A discharged seaman winds up on an old man's farm: his children left the place for the broader horizons of the evil city;the walls are near decay ,the fields lie fallow .

Title: 865. Get Going
description: Judy King (Grace McDonald), newly arrived in Washington, applies for a secretarial job with a government agency and while being interviewed by Bob Carlton (Robert Paige), an agent with the bureau, jokingly hints she may be a spy. While investigating her, he clears Judy and falls in love with her ... and then uncovers a real Nazi spy ring.

Title: 866. Mademoiselle Béatrice
description: A law student passed his exam in his first B.A. year in Paris ;he is in love with a girl who is not from the bourgeoisie and the boy is afraid his father might not approve of their union.

Title: 868. Álomkeringö
description: Gábor Turi, the star of the Viennese Opera retires from the stage after he inherits a huge piece of land in Hungary with the stipulation that he can't continue his career as a singer.

Title: 869. A láp virága
description: Miklós Pálfalvy, the easy-going son of a wealthy landowner, gets involved in bill forgery. The fake paper falls into the hands of his future father-in-law, the banker Mihályi, who blackmails the young man with it. Miklós breaks up with the Mihályi and decides to travel abroad with the rest of his money. Before leaving, he visits the beautiful flower seller Jessy, whom he has been attracted to for some time. After the beautiful day spent together, Miklós is arrested and sent to prison. In desperation, he attempts suicide, but later, when he starts working in the prison blacksmith's workshop on the advice of the priest, the pleasant fatigue of the hard work and the blacksmith's sober philosophy heal his soul.

Title: 870. Tristi amori
description: Emma, who is married to lawyer Giulio Scarli, is secretly in love with Fabrizio Arcieri, who works with her husband.

Title: 871. Yu jia nu
description: Love story of a fisherman's daughter and an art student who is the son of the accountant of a fishing despot.

Title: 872. Cándida, la mujer del año
description: After being decorated for a meritorious deed, Cándida finds herself involved in the maneuvers of some swindlers who intend to use her fame.

Title: 874. Die unheimliche Wandlung des Alex Roscher
876. Erik Ejegods pilgrimsfærd
description: A director of a traveling theater arrives in a provincial town to set up a new play.

Title: 877. El fabricante de estrellas
description: An artist manager wants to make a star out of a singing football player he has found.

Title: 879. Resurrección
description: A rich and powerful man volunteers to do jury duty in the trial of a woman accused of murder. He is shocked when he recognizes the defendant as a family servant he seduced many years ago.

Title: 880. Matura-Reise
description: Cycling through the canton of Ticino. Fourteen young women, who have just passed their Matura exams in Zurich, are undertaking this trip as a traditional end to their school days. Swiss classic starring Anne Marie Blanc, Margrit Winter, and Blanche Aubry. Directed by Sigfrit Steiner.

Title: 881. Les ailes blanches
description: Sister Claire is a nun who, besides praying God, devotes her time and energy to saving "lost girls". When Siméon, a widower, failed composer and music-hall pianist, comes to the convent to tune the harmonium, he tells her how hard it has been for him to raise his three daughters alone. And how angry he is just now with Lucette, the eldest of the three. The girl is indeed pregnant by her seducer. Hearing that, he nun suddenly remembers her own case: four decades earlier, as she was still Claire Lebourg, she too went through the pains of an unachieved love story and marriage, luckily without falling pregnant. Taking the veil and helping wretched creatures had managed to heal her distress. She will of course support Lucette in her ordeal, doing everything to spare her an abortion or a suicide. And she will see to it that she obtains forgiveness from her father as well as a warm return under his roof.

Title: 883. Behind Prison Walls
description: Business tycoon James J. "J. J." MacGlennon is found guilty of corruption and sentenced to prison, along with his son Jonathan, who testified against him but feels he is also guilty because they are related. Jonathan, an intellectual socialist, disapproves of his father's business methods, which he believes indicate that J. J. has criminal proclivities. He and J. J. bicker all the way to prison, while J. J.'s business is taken over by his greedy vice-president, Percy Webb. Although Jonathan's cellmate is surly convicted killer Frank Lucacelli, Jonathan insists that they get along, and when Frank tries to strike him, Jonathan calmly knocks the killer out and continues his exhortation about man's need for humanity. As MacGlennon Enterprises' stock drops, and Webb forms a partnership with crooked lawyer Frederick Driscoll, J. J. instructs his still-employed secretary, Elinor Cantwell, to continue to buy stock on his behalf so that Webb will never gain control of the company. J. J. goes so far as to have Elinor purchase Webb and Driscoll's potassium mine because he thinks that their business sense is so poor that the mine must be valuable if they want to get rid of it. Reporter Whitey O'Neil comes to see Elinor to confirm rumors that Elinor is engaged to Jonathan, but Elinor vehemently denies the rumor because of her intense dislike of the self-absorbed intellectual. Jonathan receives a pardon after a board of inquiry determines that he was blameless for his father's machinations. Worried that his company will go under with Webb at the helm, J. J. seizes this opportunity to convince Jonathan that he has reformed, and now wants his son to run the company as he pleases. In truth, J. J. is counting on the probability that with Jonathan in charge, stock prices will plummet, and he will be able to buy up the dominating shares. Jonathan, however, is sincere in his desire to reform American business, and immediately confides in the cleaning woman, Yettie Kropatchek, a minor stockholder. An appalled Webb is ousted, while Jonathan starts instituting radical policies and interviewing small businessmen with whom he hopes to form an alliance. When every small business owner fails to be interested in Jonathan's plan, he becomes despondent and admits to Elinor that he has overestimated his fellow man. Jonathan then confesses his love for Elinor. Elinor is so moved by his compassion that she bursts into tears, and admits that she too loves him, but has been working on his father's behalf to ensure that all the businessmen would reject Jonathan's plan. Buoyed by this news, Jonathan kisses Elinor and finds renewed vigor to revolutionize business. Jonathan's model of business succeeds so well that it becomes an asset to the war effort, and the company is hailed nationwide. Webb, Driscoll and Webb's secretary Mimi, meanwhile, plot revenge against Jonathan, and hire an ex-convict to murder him. When the killer, Frank, recognizes his former cellmate, however, he refuses to kill him because he always treated Frank as an equal. J. J., who now wholeheartedly supports his son's business theories, obtains a special one-day release to attend the stockholders' meeting, and his appearance foils Webb's last attempt to take control. Whitey writes a story about J. J.'s change, along with the fact that Frank has accused Webb of attempted murder, and announces Jonathan and Elinor's engagement. J. J., who was released only because of Whitey's influence with the governor, then goes to see his son, who, at that moment, is being lectured by a Hungarian professor. The professor convinces Jonathan that his business theories will ultimately fail, and that capitalism and individual achievement are the only business methods that work.

Title: 887. Toast of Love
description: About the Russian dancer Yolanda who arrives in Mexico with her company in 1909. There she falls in love with the young cadet Julio. However, the influential Carlos opposes this love. He wants Yolanda for himself and threatens her with a possible deportation to Siberia if she rejected his romantic advances.

Title: 892. Los hombres las prefieren viudas
description: An older single woman pretends to be a widow to get a husband but his spouse returns to her life complicating her situation.

Title: 901. She Has What It Takes
description: Fay Weston (Jinx Falkenburg), a radio singer of no consequence, pretends to be the daughter of a recently deceased Broadway stage star in order to hoodwink a Broadway producer into starring her in a planned show that is a tribute to her supposed mother.

Title: 902. The Secret Agent of Japan
description: During the Japanese occupation of the three eastern provinces, the Italian Vansper had to succumb to the Japanese army because his family was threatened by the Japanese. The Japanese secret service ordered him and his partner Lao Yin to blow up the Soviet soybean train. Vansper told the volunteer army Du Jun in the middle of the night. The volunteer army intercepted the explosives and blew up the Japanese military vehicle. In order to fight back, the Japanese kidnapped Kasb, a Jew living in Harbin, and wanted to extort money from him. Kasb refused to give in, and the Japanese army brutally killed Kasb's youngest son. Vansper provided evidence of the kidnapping case to the court, but the court declared that the Japanese soldiers involved in the kidnapping were not guilty. Lao Yin joined the Volunteer Army under the encouragement of Vansper. The Japanese army wanted to secretly execute Vansper in revenge. Vansper fled Harbin after hearing the news.

Title: 905. La vita torna
description: Betrayed by a colleague to whom he was sentimentally involved the famous actor Gino Grazioli has long since abandoned the stage. Now he is ready for a comeback and instantly falls in love with a young gifted actress.

Title: 906. Schottis
description: In 1850s Madrid the schottis is the new melody. A little boy is abandoned by his drunken father and will live a series of adventures overcoming class differences while a rich lady and a relative search for him.

Title: 907. Petticoat Larceny
description: An 11 year old radio star decides to throw in her scripts and go undercover to get a better feel for her roles, but when she is kidnapped, trouble soon follows in this comedy.

Title: 908. Raiders of San Joaquin
description: An outlaw gang is stealing land under the pretense that they are getting it for a railway.

Title: 909. Fashion
description: The film 'Fashion' begins where most other films end, i.e. on the ding-dong of marriage bells. Most people think that life is interesting only before marriage-But we think that the real life begins after marriage. As such we have presented in 'Fashion' the life story of a married couple with all the romance and pathos, the delight and grief, the blessings and worries that go along with marital life. ChandraMohan plays Yusuf who is tired of being a ghar-jamai (resident son-in-law) and decides to move to Bombay with his devoted wife Razia (played by Sardar Akhtar). Yusuf's plan is, as it always is, to make enough money in the big city to silence his snobbish father-in-law. Sabita Devi plays the part of an eye-gazing and seductive Bombay woman, Farida, a social butterfly who distracts poor Yusuf from his virtuous Razia. As the filmmakers promised, the fun only begins after the ding-dong of the marriage bells...

Title: 910. Kotovsky
description: A film about the legendary hero of the Civil War, Grigory Ivanovich Kotovsky, a revolutionary, military commander of cavalry troops: divisional commander, brigade commander, regimental commander.

Title: 911. Lermontov
description: Biographical film about the 19th century Russian writer, poet and sometimes painter Mikhail Lermontov.

Title: 912. Confessions of a Vice Baron
description: On the eve of his execution, a vice-rackets bigshot recalls his various exploits in crimes such as abortion and white slavery, in which he frequently operated under an alias.

Title: 913. The Butler's Dilemma
description: 1943. Comedy. Directed by Leslie S. Hiscott. Stars Richard Hearne, Ronald Shiner & Hermione Gingold. In debt to gamblers Rodney (Richard Hearne) agrees to pass as a butler at a gambling party.

Title: 914. Riders of the Northwest Mounted
description: Fur thieves, who murder trappers when they refuse to give up their pelts at a low price, occupy the attention of the Royal Northwest Mounted Police. The leader of the gang is Victor Renaud (Dick Curtis), also the mayor of the small Canadian town where the gang is headquartered. Lucky Kerrigan is broken from the mounted service for apparent disobedience to orders, which results in the death of a fellow Mountie. Lucky, working undercover, aids the Mounties in rounding up the gang and gains back his uniform, and also the love of Gabrielle Renaud (Adele Mara), Renaud's sister who was unaware of his criminal activities.

Title: 916. Old Mother Riley Detective
description: Old Mother Riley does her bit for the war effort by going undercover to foil a gang of black marketeers.

Title: 917. Dieciséis años
description: A naive teenager faces a distressing reality that instills in her the idea of suicide. Based on the British play Sixteen by Aimée and Philip Stuart. Follows a German film version in 1936 titled The Girl Irene "Das Mädchen Irene" directed by Reinhold Schünzel.

Title: 918. Keinumorsian
description: The daughter of a farmer falls in love with a simple miller's helper. Her father is not satisfied with the prospect, so he does not allow her to marry her lover. She later follows her parents' wishes and marries a wealthy older man. Time passes. What will happen when the mill worker returns and gets a job with the unsuspecting older man?

Title: 919. Deliciosamente tontos
description: A Cuban millionaire leaves his fortune to the first marriage to be concluded between two families, the Acevedo's and the Espinosa's, before the centenary of his death would be fulfilled. If no link, the money will go to the State. In the past, It has never been possible this union because there were no women, but now the Espinosa family has Mary, and the Acevedo's want to marry Ernesto. However Mary is in Cuba and Ernesto sends his servant's photo instead of his.

Title: 921. La suerte llama tres veces
description: When a man agrees to join a gang of criminals, his life becomes a complicated labyrinth that he will have to leave in order to be saved.

Title: 922. Yrjänän emännän synti
description: Yrjänä's farm is plagued by infertility and the lady of the house decides to get a child by any means to continue her famous family. She's in conflict with her husband and with the church.

Title: 923. I brist på bevis
description: Håkan Dahlin has been in an alcoholic institution and when he returns home he starts drinking again.

Title: 924. Barbora Hlavsová
description: Hlavsa, the widely respected manager of a small-town pawn shop, commits embezzlement because of his whimsical and dissolute wife, and when the situation cannot be saved, he shoots himself. His mother, a simple village woman, takes in her widowed daughter-in-law and teenage grandson on the condition that they both help her make up for all the damage. For the city lady, the hard village work is an ordeal. The same for young Borík, a gifted pianist who finds it hard to give up his dreams of a career as an artist.

Title: 925. Santa Fe Scouts
description: The Three Mersquiteers, Tucson Smith (Bob Steele), Stony Brooke (Tom Tyler) and Lullaby Josline (Jimmie Dodd), run into trouble trying to keep Tim Clay (John James), son of their employer Minera Clay (Elizabeth Valentine), out of trouble. They think their problems are over when Tim announces his intentions of marrying Claire Robbins (Lois Collier). But Neil MOrgan (Tom Chatterton), Minerva's lawyer, is plotting to get her ranch through resorting to the water-hole-racket of poisoning her cattle, and puts a squatter on the property, hoping to keep him there until the Squatters' Rights Bill becomes effective.

Title: 926. La guerra la gano yo
description: A grocer gets rich speculating on the shortages generated by World War II until he suffers the consequences firsthand.

Title: 927. Tierra de pasiones
description: En el pueblo de Tehuanchitán se espera la caída del primer mango, y para celebrarlo se lleva a cabo La Zandunga, fiesta tradicional donde se escribe una historia de amor.

Title: 928. T-9 Submarine
description: The Great Patriotic War. The Soviet submarine T-9, having passed through the minefields of the North Sea, penetrates into the enemy port. Sailors sink enemy transport ships, but soon find out that they were late - enemy troops and weapons have already been unloaded and sent to the front. Captain Kostrov finds himself in a situation where the combat mission is almost impossible, but he must complete it - for him it is a matter of honor or dishonor.

Title: 929. Moscow Music Hall
description: A variety of Russian stars are presented in a revue that includes many traditional songs and dances. Among the acts in this 31-minute short are: The Red Army Ensemble doing "The Red Army Anniversary Song" and "Cavalry Dance"; a ballet skit called "The Skating Dance" by Anna Redel and Mikhail Krustalev; "Lilac Blossoms" by Lidiya Ruslanova; a production number by the Piatnitsky Ensemble, and "Quadrille", a Russian folk dance.

Title: 931. Germanin - Die Geschichte einer kolonialen Tat
description: Story of German medical missionaries helping the natives in Africa.

Title: 932. Rákóczi nótája
description: Krisztinka Oltay, disguised as a gypsy woman, spies, plots and arranges to help Prince Rákóczi and free his lover, Péter Szakmáry, who has been captured by his brother, who is loyal to the Emperor, and is to be executed in Kassa with the other kuruc men. Krisztinka inspires the tired kuruc troops with a song, Rákóczi's Song, to take Kassa and free the prisoners.

Title: 935. Sivakavi
description: Based on the life story of Poyyamozhi Pulavar.

Title: 936. Frontier Law
description: Riding south from Montana, Jim Warren and his friend, Ramblin' Rufe, discover that Jim's old pal, Dusty Norton, is working for triggerman Joe Hawkins. Later, Jim and Rufe see cattleman Frank Rodgers kill cattleman Farrell in self defense, after a dispute about the illegal grazing of Farrell's stock on Rodgers' land. The only other witness is Lois, Rodgers' daughter. Rodgers is jailed, and Hawkins, who has also been stealing cattle from both ranches and altering the brands, tries to incite a lynching. Hawkins causes a confrontation between Jim and Dusty that leads to a climatic gun battle with the two old pals against the Hawkins gang.

Title: 942. Partizany v stepyakh Ukrainy
description: Soviet propaganda film. War. The entire territory of Ukraine was under occupation. With the beginning of the war, many residents of Ukrainian villages had to part with their measured village life.

Title: 943. À la Belle frégate
description: Which sailor will she choose?

Title: 944. Noches de ronda
description: In this Romantic- Musical, Ramon Armengod plays a handsome and driven but poor composer, who earns a living as a piano player with a singing voice that can melt a girl's heart. His obvious good looks and talent attract the attention of two beautiful but very different women. He soon finds himself in a situation that most men would envy. He must choose between sweet and innocent Esperanza, (nicknamed Pelancha), who hangs on his every word, or Olga, the worldly and provocative Rumberera who also happens to have connections in the music and entertainment world. Should he choose for love or his career? This film features several musical numbers by Armengod, as well as the Ballad from which this movie gets its its title.

Title: 945. Der Unendliche Weg
description: One of a series of biographical films from WWII Germany, this one about a mid 19th century economist, Friedrich List, who advocated for strong national development.

Title: 946. Boda accidentada
description: Niece of a marquise, Ketty is engaged to the wealthy holder of a cannery named Cándido. Nico, an old friend of Cándido and now completely ruined, arrives at the hotel where the couple is staying. Nico is immediately on Ketty, but unlike other men who also court her, he treats her rather indifferently. The girl, wounded in her own love, will become more and more interested in Nico. Shortly before the wedding, Cándido will be forced to leave, demanded by his businesses, ordering the friend to take care of his fiancee.

Title: 948. Joseonhaehyeob
description: The son of a noble Korean family tries to atone for the death of his brother by joining the Imperial Army, leaving behind his pregnant wife in the process.

Title: 949. Secrets
description: A penniless private tutor is hired by a wealthy family in Provence.

Title: 950. En melodi om våren
description: Sten meets Nina on a train ride. He feels attracted to her but he is already engaged to his fiancee Marie-Louise.

Title: 951. Családunk szégyene
description: Gáspár Szöcs is a middle-aged widower. For a regular alimony of $100 a month, he lies that he has two daughters instead of one: the serious Éva, who runs the household, and Lili, the debauched twin sister, the shame of the family. When the relatives arrive, Éva has to play the role of both daughters.

Title: 959. Man rede mir nicht von Liebe
description: Painter rookie Pamela plans to work in advertising but established artist Alwin falls for her and urges her to hone her craft. He guides her to fragile success, she detests being dependent on him and tries to succeed on her own.

Title: 963. Fátima, Terra de Fé
description: Having abandoned his family, due to religious incompatibility, Dr. Silveira had settled in Coimbra, where he dedicated himself to the sick, avoiding reconciliation, despite the intervention of Dr. Meneses.

Title: 964. Rosas de otoño
description: A married woman must deal with the fact that his husband flirts with every beautiful woman even when he is growing old.

Title: 965. Madame et le mort
description: A person who had usurped the identity of a famous writer of detective stories was killed in the train. Why and by whom?

Title: 967. La statua vivente
description: A sailor, Paolo, falls in love with a girl named Luisa. The two decides to get married, but on the day of the marriage the woman is involved in a serious car accident.

Title: 968. Des jeunes filles dans la nuit
description: After a fire at their boarding school, six girls return home unexpectedly, uncovering the hidden lives of their parents. From secret gambling to surprising professions, their arrival disrupts family facades and leads to romance.

Title: 969. In due si soffre meglio
description: When a rich man loses his wealth and is overcome with debts, his daughter scrambles to make a good marriage, creating a love pentangle in the process.

Title: 970. Russians at War
description: Compiled from newsreel footage taken by uncredited Soviet cameramen, the film shows scenes of life in the Soviet Union during the Winter Campaign of 1941. Cossack troops and guerilla bands are seen in action, women behind the lines are shown catching fish and building tanks for the troops, civilians and soldiers together are seen pledging large portions of their wages back to the government as loans to fund the war, Nazi airmen and troops are captured and one is shown calling on his countrymen to surrender (which some do using "passes to admit the bearer" to sanctity in the Soviet Union which the Soviet army drops behind the enemy lines), the means of getting mail and reading matter to the front lines are examined, the Nazi destruction of historic buildings such as the homes of Tolstoy and Tschaikowsky are shown... to the front is shown

Title: 972. Coup de feu dans la nuit
976. Zíznivé mládí
description: The wife of cottager Marek has an illegitimate son, Jaroslav, with landowner Navrátil, who has no interest in the boy. Marek reproaches his wife for her misbehavior even after many years, avoids working, and drinks away their money. Jaroslav is a good boy and his mother is a great support. He likes Liduska, who lives alone with her father, the ferryman Král. Her mother has long ago abandoned them. Marek makes friends with the vagabond Doubek, who usually comes to the village each summer for seasonal farm work. Doubek takes a fancy to Liduska, and the romantic adolescent girl is not indifferent to him. Jaroslav is jealous of Doubek and on account of him he quarrels with Liduska.

Title: 977. La boda de Quinita Flores
description: When Quinita's fiancee runs away on their wedding day, her brother takes her on a trip, ending at a thermal station. There she meets Eugenio, who urgently needs to marry. They like each other but he thinks the brothers are wife and husband.

Title: 978. Herr Collins äventyr
description: Filip Collin, the elegant small town patron, has suffered from money market concerns due to bankruptcy on foreign exchanges.

Title: 979. Wakaki hi no yorokobi
description: During World War II a young woman quits university and instead obtains a job at a magazine about film that her mentor set up for her. The mentor herself is an actress. Here the woman meets Hara Setsuko as a colleague. The work is hard however.

Title: 986. El triunfo del amor
description: Promising boxer José Luis turns to alcohol, while his girlfriend, Mary Tere, is a successful singer.

Title: 991. La niña está loca
description: In a train accident, Marta is mistaken for the millionaire Alicia. She cannot undo the mistake, as they believe she suffers from amnesia.

Title: 993. El misterioso señor Marquina
description: This Mystery-Crime Drama, (also released under the alternative title, "Ladron de Etiqueta"), was both written and directed by the talented Chano Urueta during the uncertain times of the Second World War. It is his attempt at dealing with the age-old theme of "good versus evil" that was so reassuringly popular during this terrifying period in world history. The film relies a bit of a twist, in that the main plot focuses on the conflict between identical twins, where one is the brother who has "gone bad" by becoming a career criminal ,(and someone who is capable of all sorts of cruel misdeeds). Not surprisingly then, in contrast, the other brother is the "good" twin, who is obviously opposes his evil sibling. In fact, He feels morally responsible as well as determined to stop him - just about any way he can. The film is complemented by its all star cast, including Actor-Director Rene Cardona, Victor and Tito Junco, Jose Pulido and Roberto Canedo, just to name a few.

Title: 994. Down Melody Lane
description: The story of a Variety Theatre, illustrated by performers from its past.
